title: Folder deleted from a file share
symptom: A folder was deleted from a shared drive last week and is now needed
user_description: I think I deleted the Q3 Reports folder from the finance drive last week by mistake. I need it for a meeting tomorrow. Please tell me it's not gone!

options.text: Tell her it is gone because it was deleted from a server
options.why: File servers often keep earlier versions, and backups exist for exactly this.

options.text: Restore the backup straight over the live share
options.why: This could overwrite other people's newer work across the whole share.

options.text: Check Previous Versions on the parent folder first, if shadow copies are on; if not, restore the folder from backup to a separate location, then confirm with her before moving it back
options.why: Previous Versions is quick when it is available. Restoring to a separate location protects newer files, and the user confirms it is the right copy.

options.text: Ask her to rebuild the reports from scratch
options.why: Wastes a lot of work when the folder can very likely be recovered.

hints: Do servers keep older copies of files?
What could go wrong if you restore over the live share?
Who should confirm the restored folder is the right one?
real_world_tip: Previous Versions only appears if shadow copies are switched on for that drive. Ask the server team how often snapshots are taken.
